test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**extinction**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the passage is global warming and its consequences, emphasizing the severe impact it can have on the planet.
 
• The last sentence of the passage talks about offering hope to leave a green planet to future generations who presently appear to face the most critical consequence due to ongoing environmental issues.
 
• "**Extinction**" fits this context best as it conveys the severity of the environmental threat facing future generations, implying the complete loss and disappearance of species.
 
• Other options ("**renovation**", "**redemption**", "**salvation**") do not fit appropriately in the context of describing such a severe threat as "extinction."

Therefore, the correct answer is '**extinction**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Global warming is a major problem. The result will be the problems created by the rising temperatures of the Arctic region. As a result of global warming, (1)* *alterations__* *in rainfall and plant distribution affect the migration patterns, feeding behaviour, and breeding preferences of numerous bird species. The increase in temperature may also alter ocean currents, which may alter the (2)* *__marine__* *ecology as a whole. Greenhouse gas emissions are responsible for the ongoing melting of the Arctic. This will result in a (3)* *__vicious__* *loop since greenhouse gases trap the heat in the atmosphere and the additional emissions may (4)* *__accelerate__* *the global warming process. Now, the only way to reverse the harm is for every person to be environmentally sensitive. This may offer us hope that we will be able to leave a green planet to our future generations, who presently appear to face (5)* *__extinction.__*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Renovation:** "Renovation" refers to the action of renovating a building, structure, etc., which is not applicable in this context.
 
• **Redemption: "**Redemption" means the action of saving or being saved from sin, error, or evil, which does not fit the context of the passage.
 
• **Salvation: **"Salvation" means deliverance from harm, ruin, or loss, which does not fit the context accurately.
